unmapped_findings: The β-Mn in the hardest 17Al sample (aged 575 °C for 6 h) had an SEM-EDS micro-area composition of Mn 36.2 at.%, Al 16.3 at.%, and Cu 2.6 at.% (Fig. 14 / b0060).

XRD (D8 Discover diffractometer) was performed on the 17Al alloy only in the 575 °C × 1 h condition (not the 6 h condition of this sample); the pattern showed α/D0₃ together with both α-Mn and β-Mn, indicating α-Mn and β-Mn co-precipitated before the α matrix fully transformed to β-Mn (b0026, b0053, figure_010).

The β-Mn of the hardest 17Al sample was indexed by SAED in [012] and [111] beams, with the [111]-beam pattern described as hexagonal β-Mn reflections; HRTEM/FFT confirmed a hexagonal spot array for β-Mn (figure_011, figure_012).

Increasing the nominal Al content of the alloy raised the Al dissolved in β-Mn (14.3 → 16.3 → 17.5 at.% for 15Al/17Al/19Al) while Mn (36.8/36.2/36.2 at.%) and Cu (2.8/2.6/2.6 at.%) stayed essentially unchanged, which the authors link to solid-solution strengthening of β-Mn (b0060, figure_014).
The α→β-Mn transformation in 17Al was complete after 6 h at 550 °C, but after only 1 h at 600 °C and above (b0053, b0065, figure_008).
